scope: Warning-level registry for entities already present in curated claims. External identifiers should be resolved from PubChem, ChEMBL, BindingDB, UniProt, Open Targets, MONDO, EFO, MeSH, and related source databases before this becomes a blocking validator.

id_policy.compounds: Prefer PubChem CID plus ChEMBL molecule ID when available; include InChIKey or canonical SMILES after structure validation.
id_policy.targets: Prefer human gene symbol and UniProt accession for protein targets; use ChEMBL target IDs for binding-assay reconciliation.
id_policy.disorders: Prefer MONDO or EFO identifiers, plus MeSH terms when literature search depends on PubMed indexing.
